title: Resolution urging discounted AirTrain JFK fares for airport workers
summary: This resolution calls on the Port Authority of New York and New Jersey to offer JFK airport employees a discounted AirTrain fare package. It notes that MTA's discontinuation of MetroCard sales as of December 2025 has left the roughly 40,000 JFK workers without an affordable alternative to the full $17.50 roundtrip AirTrain fare. The Council urges the Port Authority to establish a new discount option now that OMNY is replacing MetroCards.
